message: AssetData now includes FundingSourceName and four LastVerification columns (Date, Type, Location, Success) pulled directly from the asset search payload. AssetData widens from 33 to 38 columns; formula columns AgeDays/AgeYears/WarrantyStatus shift from AE-AG to AJ-AL. Run Setup Spreadsheet (destructive) or Full Reload to rebuild AssetData with the new layout. Manage Deployments → New version to update the dashboard.
